newsitem.title: POLAND: BPH TO BUY COOPERATIVE BANK - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: BPH TO BUY COOPERATIVE BANK - PAPER.

text.p: Poland's Bank Przemyslowo- Handlowy (BPH) plans to buy a cooperative bank to help service firms in the agriculture and food-processing sectors, BPH's president told the daily Nowa Europa on Tuesday.
"Bank Przemyslowo-Handlowy is currently finalising the purchase of a majority stake in a cooperative bank," Nowa Europa quoted Henryka Pieronkiewicz as saying.
Poland currently has 1,600 small cooperative banks, 1,200 of them grouped in Bank Gospodarki Zywnosciowej (BGZ).

The agriculuture minister said earlier this month that the long process of restructuring Poland's ailing cooperative sector should end this year with the creation of a three-tier system of cooperative, regional and nationwide banks.
Before the scheme started two years ago nearly one-third of the country's cooperative banks were in danger of bankruptcy after a huge wave of bad loans to farmers in the early 1990s.
